packName: Poly Haven asset (individual model, not a pack)
creator: Luis Jose Fernandez Rodriguez, via Poly Haven (polyhaven.com)
attributionNote: Not legally required under CC0; Poly Haven asks for a credit as courtesy only.
redistributionStatus: Permitted without restriction under CC0. Redistributed here as a single-file GLB converted via assimp from Poly Haven's official 1k glTF export (gltf + bin + diffuse/normal/ARM jpg textures), all three source files verified against the md5 checksums published by the Poly Haven API before conversion.

validation.notes: Validated via Node script parsing GLB binary header + JSON chunk only; not opened in a 3D viewer. Bounding box (~0.13 m tall) is smaller than Poly Haven's stated ~0.4 m real-world height for this scan -- likely a unit/scale convention difference in the glTF export, re-check scale before placing in a scene.

note: Brass vintage microscope, real photogrammetry/PBR scan. Candidate for the Human Physiology 'Microscope mode' interactive component and general non-anatomy lab-equipment set dressing. Not a stylized asset -- visual style differs from the app's low-poly Quaternius nature/ecology assets; flag for art-direction review before use alongside them in the same scene.
